summary: Danaher filed an 8-K on October 13, 2026, reporting that on October 9 the Board expanded to thirteen members and appointed Daniel L. Comas and Dr. Robert M. Hershberg as directors, effective immediately. Both will serve until the next annual meeting; Dr. Hershberg also joined the Science and Technology Committee. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or closing terms were disclosed. The filing is a routine board-composition update under Item 5.02, not a transaction; watch for any subsequent strategic or capital-allocation signals from the newly constituted board.
